rundown: Terrapins beat Lady Bears 109-39 at XFINITY Center in College Park, MD. Terrapins led 53-9 at the half and never looked back. The 2nd quarter decided it: Terrapins won it 24-0. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 100%).
Leading the way — Lady Bears: Dru Carlton 17 pts; Kenya Ramsey 3 ast; Merit Innocent 8 reb. Terrapins: Oluchi Okananwa 20 pts; Addi Mack 6 ast; Oumou Thiero 12 reb.
Where Terrapins won it: they shot 57% to 23%, shot 30% from three to 14% and won the boards 61-27.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Terrapins closed as 50.5-point favorites and covered by 19.5; the total closed at 142.5 and they combined for 148, over by 5.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 21, 11:55 AM ET. It had Lady Bears 0% and Terrapins 100%, projecting Lady Bears 42.3 – Terrapins 92.3 (134.6 total, Terrapins by 49.9).

Final: Lady Bears 39 – Terrapins 109. Right winner: it had Terrapins at 100%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Lady Bears came in with a 17% below average attack and a 8% leakier than average defense (2-5, 59 scored and 73.3 allowed a game over 7 games), worth about 166 and 169 games of evidence. Projected to score 42.3, they scored 39 (−3.3 points, 8% under); projected to allow 92.3, they allowed 109 (+16.7 points, 18% over).

Terrapins came in with a 21% above average attack and a 16% stingier than average defense (3-1, 85.8 scored and 63 allowed a game over 4 games), worth about 173 and 172 games of evidence. Projected to score 92.3, they scored 109 (+16.7 points, 18% over); projected to allow 42.3, they allowed 39 (−3.3 points, 8% under).

The bigger miss was Terrapins' scoring (+16.7 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 148 against 134.6 projected (+13.4), about the 83rd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14).

Margin: Terrapins by 70 against Terrapins by 49.9 projected, about the 94th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±13).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
MD -45.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+1.4 pts) — won (+0.9u); beat the closing -50.5 by 5. MORG +45.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-1.4 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the closing +50.5 by 5. OVER 142.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 48% vs 50% fair (-2.3 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. UNDER 142.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 52% vs 50% fair (+2.3 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: spread Terrapins -45.5 → -50.5.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.070 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +21.4 points. It counts toward NCAAW scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 843 graded NCAAW games the algo now scales scoring ×0.974 and gives home teams +1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Lady Bears attack ×0.964, defense ×1.027 (7 games); Terrapins attack ×1.016, defense ×0.960 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 20.1 points), no bet.
